about: Site markets and their compositions. County is the atomic unit. A CBSA market takes its member counties from the OMB delineation file; a judgement composition carries review = true and its basis. State ids are USPS codes in lower case; market ids are <state-slug>/<market-slug>. Assembled by docs/web-fsc-5/tools/assemble_geographies.py from the composition drafts in docs/web-fsc-5/compose/.

id_scheme.ct_component: <market>:legacy or <market>:pr (Connecticut FOIA loans by coding scheme)
id_scheme.county: co-<5-digit FIPS> once a Census county roster is fetched
id_scheme.cbsa: cbsa-<5-digit code> once the delineation is fetched

counties.reason: No federal county roster was reachable: the Census Data API needs a key (DECISIONS D2) and www2.census.gov is closed by robots.txt (D1). County FIPS codes in the market rows are the composer's, marked fips_verified false.

cbsas.reason: The OMB delineation file (list1_2023.xlsx) is on www2.census.gov (D1) and the geoinfo API needs a key (D2). CBSA codes in the market rows are the composer's, marked verified false.
